newsitem.title: USA: U.S. film group denies authenticating Monroe movie.
newsitem.headline: U.S. film group denies authenticating Monroe movie.

text.p: The American Film Institute (AFI) on Wednesday denied reports from Spain that it had authenticated a 50-year-old pornographic film purportedly showing Hollywood legend Marilyn Monroe engaging in a sexual act.

Anna Strasberg, the Monroe estate's licensing agent, suggested the film might be a fake, and an attorney for the late movie star's estate said he would launch an investigation to see if it was all a hoax.
AFI spokesman Seth Oster said it was "absolutely untrue" his organisation had confirmed in a letter to the film's apparent owner in Spain last month that the woman in the short movie was Monroe.

The denial came in response to a claim by a film festival organiser, Mario Prades, who said in Madrid earlier on Wednesday that he would show the silent 6-1/2 minute porno film at his festival on Feb. 1 and 2.
Prades said the film was owned by an anonymous short film maker from the northeast of Spain, and had been bought for a few dollars at a Paris flea market in 1977.

He said the film was made in 1947 and showed a blonde woman doing a striptease and then engaging in an explicit sexual act with a man. Prades reportedly said the AFI confirmed in a letter to the film's owner last month that the woman in the film was Monroe, who died in 1962.

"The AFI has not in any way been in contact with and knows nothing about what this man is saying. We are not in the business of authenticating such things," Oster said of the claim. "This is outrageous."
Anna Strasberg, contacted at her New York office, said she had heard nothing about the existence of such a film. Asked if she felt it was a hoax she replied: "I know it is.
"It is really quite sad that someone would do this to someone who was loved so much," she said.
Irving Seideman, attorney for the Monroe estate said he too knew nothing about such a film and said: "The estate will be conducting a vigorous investigation of the falsehoods."
